title: Muchengeti ari pamucheto weRwizi
intro: Munyika umo mutemo wemudzvinyiriri waiunza kusuruvara kumisha yakawanda, mweya wakagamuchira shoko raikunda kutya kwose. Nemwoyo wakazara nekuvimba, vakatanga chiito chekutenda chaizochinja mafambiro erudzi. Mvura payaitakura mutoro unokosha, tariro yakavhengana nemvura.
clues: Ndakaisa mwana wangu mubhokisi ndokuriisa pamusoro pemvura.
Mwana wangu akawanikwa nevemhuri yemutongi, asi mumwe mwana wangu akatevera.
Ndakasanganazve nemwana wangu kuti ndimuyamwise, sezvakavimbiswa naAllah.
arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
